question: What happens to ritual performers who lack knowledge after reaching heaven?
premises: Those devoid of knowledge perform sacrifices and oblations and go to heaven.
Their stay in heaven ends when that merit is exhausted.
They return to the human world according to the remainder of their merit.
inference: Ritual merit without knowledge grants only a temporary ascent to heaven followed by return to the human world.
plain_english: Those who perform sacrifices and oblations but lack knowledge go from here to heaven; when that merit is exhausted, they return to the human world according to the merit that remains.
